purpose: Compare CNN-only and current regressor compositions under the same present-day pipeline, focusing on ONB-stage missed detections, false alarms, noise degradation, and predictive error structure.

interpretation.primary_comparison: A versus B: equal model count, composition-level comparison
interpretation.system_comparison: A/B versus C: includes member count, representation and integration-constraint differences
interpretation.conformer_label: The current key refers to CNN+Transformer, not an assertion of the Conformer paper architecture.
interpretation.development_comparison: Newly tuned A versus frozen existing B/C includes unequal tuning histories. Stronger composition claims need comparable tuning opportunity or explicit limitations.
interpretation.outer_test_status: Repeatedly consulted development evaluation, not an untouched final independent test

architecture_requirements.output: One continuous heat-flux regression output with the current target transformation and inverse transformation
architecture_requirements.regression_heads: Record the selected regression implementations; do not silently replace heads or claim exact restoration of a past training run.

proposed_weight_fit.arms_A_and_B: The same nonnegative simplex MSE fit on aligned clean training OOF predictions
proposed_weight_fit.equal_weight_control: Optional calculation from the same saved single-model predictions
proposed_weight_fit.arm_C: Preserve the existing fixed-core/addition constraints and disclose them in the system comparison
proposed_weight_fit.onb_objective_reweighting: Separate question; do not change it simultaneously in the composition comparison

initial_tuning_proposal_not_adopted.primary_metric: Clean OOF all-range RMSE to match the composition comparison's existing optimization target
initial_tuning_proposal_not_adopted.batch_size_resolution: Confirm feasibility on training-side pilot inputs before ranking candidates
initial_tuning_proposal_not_adopted.interpretation: OOF candidate ranking and weight fit are development operations, not independent performance estimates. Do not add candidates until outer results improve.

required_evaluation: ONB-near errors with the actual sample count and stage coverage
Recorded ONB-stage TP/FN by source day
FN/FP/TP/TN and derived rates by day and noise level
Day-specific q100, without conversion to seconds
Absolute noisy error and clean-to-noisy degradation separately
Paired correction/new-error counts and regional error changes
Training/validation error, selected hyperparameters, fit time and memory
resolved_implementation_requirements: Add isolated comparison builders/registry entries for log-power ResNet50 and VGG16
The current fixed-core validator requires RF/CNN+Transformer/AlexNet and cannot directly fit arm A
Provide a comparison-only weighting path while retaining the current production strategy
Verify training-only candidate routing, aligned OOF IDs, saved artifacts, and prediction reload

expanded_search.note: Earlier initial_tuning_proposal_not_adopted describes the prior small-grid proposal, not the active grid.
